Overview

Blockchain & Digital Trust for Advertising & MarTech earns its budget only when it changes a number on someone's scorecard. So we invert the usual sequence: lock the metric and its baseline first, then work backwards to the smallest architecture that moves it — usually composed from OSS/BSS stacks and the tower platform rather than built from scratch. For Telecom, Media & Entertainment, the design tension is specific — churn propensity on one side, GDPR / privacy regimes on the other, and a control environment that must survive both internal audit and external inspection. We build for that tension explicitly rather than discovering it at gate review.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
The ways programs like this die — and the guard we ship against each:

items: Key fragility
Keys rotated on ceremony with HSM custody — the compromise of one secret is never the compromise of the estate.
On-chain PII
Personal data never written on-ledger — hashes and references only, verified in design review.
Ledger worship
The ledger used where tamper-evidence earns its cost — everything else stays a database with a backup.
